reviews.review:
To any Inscryption player looking at this thinking it can scratch that itch, There is a fundamental flaw in the game design that you can very simply generalize as: (Inscryption but there is no sigils). 

To go into detail of what I mean by this, the game plays like a turn based chess (Something like Heroes of might and magic 3) but it provides no interesting build potential to its chess pieces. Every piece in the game basically boils down to 5 basic attributes, that being Movement, Health, Attack range, Damage and Defense.(Which is standard for any game Mostly) 
And that is it. You can only modify these five aspects of your pieces, there are two types of damages that is countered by two types of defenses and this ratio is literally 1:1 so if your piece has 1 basic attack and tries to attack a piece that has 1 basic armor it will deal 0 damage.
-
This leads to a problem of not having anything fun or creative to make or cook up, because there is literally no variable or effect to add besides just changing the numbers of those 5 basic stats. So mostly all the pieces of the game feel exactly the same aside from a few exceptions of having super long range or super high damage but that isn't super FUN.
-
The other problem with Gameplay is the AI, it will simply never move except only when one of its pieces is in range of yours. Combined with what I mentioned about attacks and armor in this game it leads to the gameplay loop of leading your HIGH defense unit just one tile in range of an enemy that Can't break its defense and then ending your turn, after which the one piece will charge out of position and deal nothing and you can swarm him. And That is it, That is literally-Fundamentally the Most Optimal play for the whole gameplay for every combat encounter.
-
Another unacceptably boring part of the game is Upgrading your pieces, you can do this at any time outside of combat by gold you gain from playing the board, Upgrades are for a "Piece Type" meaning that if you upgrade your "Cultist Piece" every "Cultist Piece" you will ever find will also have all of those upgrades. 

Now it doesn't sound that bad by itself but the real ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ WTF Kicker is the fact that the enemy chess pieces LITERALLY Increase in Strength based on your OWN Upgrades even On the same Previous Battle Encounters!  

This leads to a psychological feedback loop of Why the ♥♥♥♥ Do I even bother upgrading anything if the enemy pieces also upgrade?? Its not like you get anything enjoyable besides Increasing those 5 basic stats which won't even matter since all the enemy pieces will also increase those same 5 basic stats.
-
I genuinely tried to enjoy the game because its visuals and design are great and clearly a lot of work went into the atmosphere and delivery, however the gameplay is just Poorly thought out and Its simply BORING. 
No matter how clever you are in writing or beautiful in your art, if a game is Literally Boring then it really will just overshadow everything else when it comes to being a video game..
